title: Teach Ask Aven new words
summary: Ask Aven changes objects from plain requests like 'make it faster'. Teach it other ways people say the same thing.
why: People describe things in many ways. The more Ask Aven understands, the less beginners get stuck.

steps.text: Select an object and try requests in the Ask box in the Inspector. Note ones it doesn't understand, like 'make it zoomier'.
Open editor/data/assistant_words.json. Each word on the left is one Ask Aven knows; the list holds words that mean the same.
Add your words to the right list (or a new entry for a word Ask Aven already knows).
Try the request again: it works now (the file is read again when it changes).
Send it as a pull request.

submit: Open a pull request with your change to editor/data/assistant_words.json. Put 'Quest: teach-ask-aven' in the description.
